title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-03-20
lineage: SBD > MR > ? > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Patchy matrix recording with occasional clarity; Cold Rain & Snow and Good Lovin' stand out amid a confusing, jumbled set.
ai_review.review: The tape is a mish‑mash of two incomplete sources (soundboard and venue‑mic) that results in uneven sound quality—some sections are clear while others are muddy or mis‑identified. Musically the performance has highlights, notably Jerry Garcia’s solo on “Cold Rain & Snow” and a solid “Good Lovin’”, but the overall flow is hard to follow because tracks from different dates are interleaved.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split between praise for a few songs and criticism of the chaotic, low‑fidelity source; average user rating is ~2.2, so the AI gives a modest 2.6 reflecting some musical value despite poor recording consistency.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Combination of soundboard (SBD) and venue‑mic (AUD/VLB) tracks; sections vary from decent clarity to muffled or mismatched audio, with noticeable drop‑outs and confusing track order.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is heavily scrambled—tracks from the March 20 1970 show are interleaved with filler from the November 11 1970 show, making the concert flow hard to follow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Nice solo on Cold Rain & Snow noted by reviewers.
